blocks.orig: Rounding off your wedding (or renewing) your vows together with the Maasai is a colourful, energizing, and very romantic way to celebrate your love. You join in a traditional ceremony in the middle of the African savannah, dressed in colourful Maasai wedding atire and surrounded by the community. The groom is led by the warriors, the bride by the Maasai mamas, and once united, the couple is blessed by a tribe’s elder and joined under one Maasai shuka. The ceremony ends with traditional celebrations, followed by a barbecue goat meal served as breakfast, lunch, or an early dinner, depending on the timing of the ceremony.
blocks.html: Celebrating your wedding (or the renewal of your vows) with the Maasai is a colourful, uplifting and deeply romantic way to mark your love. You take part in a traditional ceremony out on the African savannah, wearing vibrant Maasai wedding attire and surrounded by the community. Warriors lead the groom and the Maasai mamas lead the bride; once together, the couple receives a blessing from one of the tribe’s elders and is wrapped in a single Maasai shuka. Traditional festivities close the ceremony, followed by a barbecued goat meal served as breakfast, lunch or an early dinner, depending on when the ceremony takes place.
